results.expected: Current evidence and contributing policies are distinguishable.
evidence: Clicked current device member readings, other-readings disclosure, entity member, native entity link (intercepted in this isolated fixture), Why this is monitored and Technical details disclosures, contributing policy and Sources return. Verified unavailable/no-value/numeric distinctions, separate device/entity contributions, retained reconciliation timestamp, exact policy editor and no configuration mutation. Retry reading and issue navigation were exercised in sources.history.

results.expected: Recorded membership survives unavailable current source metadata.
evidence: Clicked Sources, MQTT, History disclosure and cleared/joined/removed rows; followed related issue into Sources and used Back with focus return. Verified recorded ownership/name after current child deletion, retention text, stale read-only/reconnect, actual Retry reading/Retry connection, no mutations and no horizontal overflow at the recorded card width.

results.controls: Equipment maintenance entry, explicit expiry, cancel
results.expected: A source has a reachable maintenance action with exact saved scope and visible expiry.
evidence: Clicked source maintenance entry, invalid custom time, explicit preset duration, optional reason, dependent-scope choice, Save and End now. Verified collapsed options, no pristine validation warning and retained exact expiry. Verified pending-click suppression, ambiguous failure with no retry, disconnected submission gate, exact mock persisted source/expiry/reason, reopened source control and preservation of an overlapping window on cancellation.

validation.workflow: Actual local component with synthetic data and mocked saves and destinations; no live Home Assistant or delivery requests

visual_review.sizes: Phone fixtures use a 390px app width inside a 1280x720 browser; desktop uses the available browser width. These are responsive fixture checks, not physical device testing.
visual_review.outcome: Repeated routes, headings and explanations removed; detailed evidence, filters and advanced settings remain reachable. Focused editors have one visible return action. Source tree return remains reachable when arriving from an issue.

independent_review: Separate Sources, editor and Settings reviews; follow-up review caught repeated method names, daily schedule verbosity, redundant editor tabs and stale navigation context. Corrections are included.
limits: No live installation or notification delivery tested
This bounded presentation and workflow review does not establish full product acceptance or large-installation performance
